identity.title: ALMA Survey of Lupus Protoplanetary Disks. I. Dust and Gas Masses

paper_type_evidence.quote: We use ALMA to survey 89 protoplanetary disks around stars with $M_{\ast}>0.1~M_{\odot}$ in the young (1–3 Myr), nearby (150–200 pc) Lupus complex.

evidence.quote: In general, Lupus III is at $\sim$200 pc while Lupus I, II, and IV are at $\sim$150 pc, though distance estimates vary due to the depth of the complex.

question.value: What are the bulk dust and gas masses of a near-complete sample of Lupus disks, how do they depend on stellar mass, and how do they compare to other regions and to planet formation constraints?

evidence.quote: We present the first high-resolution sub-mm survey of both dust and gas for a large population of protoplanetary disks.
Our ALMA Cycle 2 observations (Project ID: 2013.1.00220.S) were obtained on 2015 June 14
